lead: `schedule::tests::a_fleet_lease_is_renewed_while_its_run_is_in_flight` can fail one `bun nv verify` run and pass the next with nothing changed.
body: It asserts the lease was renewed *while* the run was still in flight, so the renewing task missing its slice reads exactly like a broken renewal, and `nv verify` runs the server's test binary beside every other one on purpose. Re-run `bun nv verify` once before reading it as a regression — twice red is a real one, and `nv verify`'s own message about a test that "passed alone" is the tell.
